identity_boundaries.artifact_manifest_digest: sha256 of the canonical artifact-manifest JSON
identity_boundaries.artifact_content_digest: sha256 of the canonical sorted file inventory
identity_boundaries.filesystem_custody: the loader pins one non-symlink evidence-root descriptor; root, opened directories, and leaves require the validator UID/GID and reject group/world writes; regular leaves require exactly one link while POSIX directory link counts are pinned and rechecked; every canonical component uses no-follow openat, one bounded leaf read, and post-read root/directory/leaf identity checks, so root-path replacement cannot redirect custody and symlink or atomic-swap races fail closed; receipts, attestations, manifests, and raw JSON use one bounded strict parser with byte/depth/node/collection/string/numeric limits, unique keys, finite numbers, and CatalogError-normalized failures without reopening the subject
identity_boundaries.session_id: one strong sha256 value shared by every attestation in one binding validation
identity_boundaries.nonce: unique strong sha256 value per signed subject
identity_boundaries.semantic_request_contract: packaged exact ordered request IDs and payload hashes plus licensed assets
identity_boundaries.gateway_smoke: signed gateway/backend Service UIDs, operation, proxy transport, and readiness identity
identity_boundaries.node_local_content: gated-unimplemented until a reviewed local-PV/PVC lifecycle rejoins WaitForFirstConsumer, exact PV/PVC/Node identity, activation generation, staging, runtime, backend capability, and cleanup; model and localizer Pods consume PVCs, never hostPath
identity_boundaries.provider_block_content: Qwen first lane only: a signed server-observed fs2-network-ssd-retain UID/resourceVersion and exact Compute CSI spec receipt is mandatory before PVC render; a separate API/controller/ValidatingAdmissionPolicy/Lease receipt binds an unpaginated complete API-observed empty claim mount set, controller-only Job creation, and the sole writer operation, rejecting same-node second writers; the closed handoff proves the Lease released, zero active writer UIDs, read-only runtime admission, controlled detach then attach without Multi-Attach, exact manifest recheck, semantics, and retained Bound claim after scale-to-zero
identity_boundaries.acquisition_helper: the catalog owns the helper repository suffix, package/lock digests, entrypoint and deterministic UID/GID/fsGroup; a fresh signed admission binds exact OCI digest, registry identity, signature, SLSA provenance, SPDX SBOM and reviewed Git source before a suspended Job may be unsuspended
identity_boundaries.acquisition_job_cleanup: the in-Pod worker result is not promotion evidence; the final acquisition receipt is created only after an API observer binds Job UID, Pod UID and owner join, deletes with exact UID preconditions, observes absence or a distinct untouched replacement UID, and proves no foreign UID was touched
identity_boundaries.sfs_content: acquisition receipt is the placement subject; no node-local staging receipt or serving-node affinity is permitted
identity_boundaries.cleanup: attempt ID, runtime tuple, exact Node/GPU identity, and expected Kubernetes resource UID set
identity_boundaries.route_valid_until: serving binding equals the earlier of every reopened signed-subject expiry and the live activation-controller Lease expiry; per-request valid_at revalidation removes stale holders
identity_boundaries.activation_controller: gateway has no Kubernetes mutation authority and no controller endpoint; the durable PostgreSQL transport binds exact submitter and claim-owner Deployment/Pod/ServiceAccount UIDs, observed pre-created DSN Secret UID/resourceVersion/key sets, least-privilege database roles/grants, controller Deployment, leader Lease UID/resourceVersion/holder/renewal, immutable intent-interface identity, and the packaged canonical DDL digest
identity_boundaries.activation_intent: gateway commits only subject fields using fs2_activation_submitter; fs2_activation_claim_owner alone claims/completes under the exact Lease holder, Pod and ServiceAccount identities, DB-clock claim expiry, idempotency subject, previous/current per-model fencing tokens allocated by advisory-lock plus target-state CAS, and exact scale contract; stale or replay-substituted tokens are rejected
identity_boundaries.scale_lifecycle: zero-to-ready binds its durable activate intent and return-to-zero binds the next monotonic deactivate intent; both prove exact controller, scale contract, runtime tuple, target UID/generation, activation-only managedFields ownership of spec.replicas, GitOps exclusion, and signed non-replayed attestations; mounted Qwen/GLM/CXR startup additionally binds exact argv/content URI and an API-observed deny-egress policy plus blocked network canary
identity_boundaries.return_to_zero: cooldown, drain, target replica zero, expected UID set, foreign-UID exclusion, zero assignments/GPU clients, and retained artifacts reconcile
identity_boundaries.model_variant_promotion: the source-only index and JSON shapes have no route authority; a separately signed live overlay binds one explicit fallback candidate/profile/full-variant identity, reads the ordered path/size/SHA artifact manifest and raw Cosign-style DSSE/SLSA/SPDX/scan bytes through custodied descriptors and parses those exact bytes without a pathname reopen, exact B300 SM103 runtime tuple, globally unique ordered non-overlapping Pod/Node/GPU attempts, per-attempt cold zero/Pod-absence/new-process/cache boundaries, distinct failure-complete cold n>=3 and warm n>=10 cohorts with recomputed bounded failure rates, API/Event-backed old-fenced distinct-replacement preemption bound to the exact attempt/semantic pair, raw Service-to-EndpointSlice-to-Pod-to-Node/GPU/PodResources/probe readiness, signed zero-ready-zero lifecycle bytes, and a review under one enabled canonical raw-key principal and distinct group per exact role; the normal serving binding must itself be enabled, ready, fresh, and rejected at exact expiry
